main.description: A file or folder in a drive. The record key is its permanent ID: renames and moves update the record, never the key.

name.description: File or folder name. Not empty, not '.' or '..', no '/'.

parent.description: Record key of the folder this is in. Absent for the top level.

sha256.description: Files only: hex SHA-256 of the whole file.

chunks.description: Files only: the contents, split into blobs. Concatenated in order, they are the file.

modifiedAt.description: Files only: the file's own modification time.

version.description: Record key of the node's current version (me.jsnelgro.atdrive.version): the change that left it like this.

contentsFrom.description: Files only: record key of the version that holds these chunks in history.
